text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart's training continues. Facing 
it stoically without compromising a single 
day— for she cannot survive any other way.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, apparently this year's Tiara 
contenders are on fire! I heard a bunch of 
super talented girls are competing.”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The Tiara route, huh... Speaking of which, 
Heart-san is entering another race, right? 
—Man, that generation was fiery too~.

might still be feeling a little sluggish."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's getting harder to shake off 
fatigue... Time really is cruel, isn't it?

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text: Yes. My mind is already made up.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Pushing relentlessly down this harsh road— 
To connect these cherished days to the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Right! Let's do our best today, too!
